content.text: New York Half Marathon 2026 Number of participants 28.000 Event Location Nueva York Race type With a slight elevation From Prospect Park to Central Park The United Airlines NYC Half is one of the most prestigious events on the international racing calendar and a unique opportunity to experience the vibrant spirit of New York while taking part in an elite sporting event. Organized by NYRR, the same team behind the iconic New York City Marathon, this half marathon allows you to run through the Big Apple, surrounded by a passionate crowd cheering you on every step of the way. With an electrifying atmosphere, the event takes place around St. Patrick’s Day, one of the most celebrated holidays in the United States. Runners will enjoy a truly special experience, passing through iconic landmarks such as Times Square, which is rarely closed to traffic and, on this occasion, is reserved exclusively for race participants. If you want to soak in the energy of one of the world’s most dynamic cities but aren’t ready for a full marathon, the New York Half Marathon is the perfect event for you. The New York City Half Marathon features a course that blends iconic landmarks with the city’s vibrant energy. Redesigned in 2018, the race kicks off in Brooklyn’s lively Prospect Park, a beloved green space known for its dynamic atmosphere. From there, runners cross the East River via the spectacular Brooklyn Bridge, one of the city’s most breathtaking structures, offering stunning views of the Manhattan skyline. Once in Manhattan, the course winds through the historic Lower East Side, immersing participants in the city’s authentic urban spirit. Runners then make their way toward Midtown, where they get the rare opportunity to race through Times Square, closed to traffic for this special occasion. The journey culminates in Central Park, New York’s iconic green oasis, where a thrilling atmosphere awaits at the finish line. With wide, traffic-free streets and the electric energy of cheering New Yorkers at every mile, the New York Half Marathon is perfect for both runners aiming to push their limits and those preparing for the legendary New York Marathon.
